title: release-engineering-meeting-notes-2026-09-08
content:
Release Engineering Meeting Notes - 2026-09-08

Attendees:
- Aisha Patel (owner)
- Miguel Santos
- Zoe Kim
- Connor Lee
- Priya Desai (SRE - joined for rollout discussion)
- Notes: recorded in Slack thread #release-engineering

Agenda:
1) Release train status for 2026-09-08 (v1.18 candidates)
2) Hotfix HOT-89 deployment postmortem and rollback plan
3) Changelog highlights for marketing + release notes
4) Blockers & capacity planning for next week
5) Action items and owners

1) Release train status
- Current train: v1.18-rc2 targeting GA 2026-09-10.
- RC1 issues: RE-2301 (KV cache regressions) fixed in PR #1709, re-run perf jobs.
- RC2 includes: kernel selection improvements (PR 1715), batching changes for small requests, updated alert thresholds.
- Canary rollout: 10% traffic to dedicated pool in us-west2 as of 09:00. No errors observed in first 3h.
- Metrics: p50 latency +3% on long prompt tests (internal benchmark suite). Miguel investigating whether batching thresholds introduced small tail impact.

2) Hotfix HOT-89 (embedding index corruption)
- Incident summary: embedding index write path corrupted a subset of indexes when shard rebalancer ran concurrently with index compaction (2026-09-07 22:12 UTC).
- Impact: small number of customers (5) experienced failed embedding lookups leading to 500 responses. No PII exposed.
- Root cause: race condition in compaction + rebalancer (see JIRA HOT-89).
- Fix applied: HOT-89-fix patch merged (PR 1723), includes in-memory mutex around compaction and improved retry logic.
- Deployment: staged to prod hotfix channel at 02:30 UTC on 2026-09-08. Observed successful healing and index repairs via backfill job (backfill job id: BACKFILL-2026-09-08-01).
- Rollback plan: if anomalies detected, revert to snapshot 2026-09-07-22-00 using restore script restore_index_v2.sh. Connor will keep restore ready and SRE on-call paged.
- Postmortem TODO: assign owner + timeline. Zoe to draft initial postmortem by 2026-09-10.

3) Changelog / release notes highlights
- User-facing items to call out for v1.18:
  - Improved throughput for mixed short/long prompt workloads (batching changes).
  - Fixed rare embedding index corruption (HOT-89) - note that customers with impacted indexes will see a short repair window.
  - Experimental kernel selection opt-in flag for customers on Dedicated (feature flag: kernel-opt-v2).
- Marketing asked for concise bullet points by 9/9 EOD. Aisha will provide drafts; Priya to validate SRE wording for incident notes.

4) Blockers & capacity planning
- Blocker: performance regression on some long-prompt perf tests (p95) possibly related to KV cache TTL changes. Miguel assigned to triage (RE-2345). Target is to have root cause by 2026-09-09 noon.
- Capacity: Dedicated pools in eu-west1 are at 82% committed for next week. Release team to coordinate with capacity planning to allow canary expansion to 20% if needed.
- Test infra: load generator for 1.18 needs update to simulate function-calling streams (work in PR 1730). QA to prioritize.

5) Action items
- Miguel: triage p95 regression (RE-2345). Update by 2026-09-09 12:00.
- Zoe: draft HOT-89 postmortem and initial customer-facing summary. Due 2026-09-10. Linked artifact: JIRA HOT-89.
- Connor: keep rollback/restore scripts validated and on-call aware. Confirm restore playbook by 2026-09-08 18:00.
- Aisha: prepare release notes bullets for marketing; coordinate wording with Priya. Due 2026-09-09 EOD.
- Priya: confirm SRE runbook updates (post-hotfix) and add health checks for embedding index errors. Due 2026-09-10.
- QA: prioritize load generator PR 1730 to cover function-calling stream tests.

Misc notes / quick wins:
- Consider adding a short delay between compaction and rebalancer start to avoid races as a guard until more robust locking is in place. Miguel to test in staging.
- Add additional synthetic checks that hit embedding index compaction path nightly to catch regressions earlier.

Next meeting:
- Weekly sync: 2026-09-15 10:00 PT. Focus: GA readiness checklist, p95 regression update, and HOT-89 postmortem review.

References:
- JIRA: RE-2345 (p95 regression triage)
- JIRA: HOT-89 (embedding index corruption)
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/1723
- Backfill job: BACKFILL-2026-09-08-01
- Slack: #release-engineering thread (link in Confluence page CONFLUENCE:conf-4821)

Notes to self:
- Keep customer comms conservative: emphasize limited impact and fix deployed.
- Check with Legal if need to escalate for customers with SLA credits.

End of notes.
